digest.component_or_area: review-bot finding publication and Gerrit rendering
propositions: Advisory finding text is never enumerated in the review message body on PASS or BLOCK paths; only a count of findings is published
Finding location metadata is discarded by _translate_findings before reaching the Gerrit layer, preventing inline comment anchoring
The post_vote call never supplies the robot_comments parameter, falling back to a single PATCHSET_LEVEL comment carrying only the message string and no per-file comment map
Robot comments are disabled on this Gerrit server, making the review message body the only proven surface for finding visibility
Advisory findings must be enumerated in the message body for both PASS and BLOCK outcomes, with inline comments as an additive enhancement when locations anchor to real revision paths
